title: SKILL.md Frontmatter Schema
description: Required frontmatter for every SKILL.md. Drives marketplace listing, routing, and IDE discovery.

name.description: Lowercase hyphenated skill name. Must exactly match the directory name.

description.description: Trigger description. Used by IDE discovery and skill routing. Must be specific enough for an agent to decide whether to activate this skill.

compatibility.description: Short note on what platforms, tools, or context this skill requires.
